prompt:
Character reference sheet, one wide image in two parts, photorealistic photograph. LEFT two-thirds: full-body turnaround of the same person, three views side by side at identical scale: front view, exact 90-degree side view, exact 180-degree back view, relaxed A-pose. RIGHT third: close-up head-and-shoulders portrait of the SAME person facing camera, mouth closed. Plain light-grey background, soft even studio light at a neutral white balance, no shadows, natural skin texture with pores, no text, no labels, no watermark.
The person: George, a fictional 55-year-old, Natalie's father, head of the Quinn family, remarried to Lauren; the face, skin and build of exactly that age, which the role does not change. Appearance: Man of 55 with a broad square face, softening jawline, deep forehead lines and slightly hooded brown eyes. He has a neatly trimmed short salt-and-pepper beard. Short dark-brown hair, greying at the temples, is combed back. He is average build with a slight paunch and about 178 cm tall. He wears a plain steel wristwatch and a gold wedding band.. Wearing one outfit only: A camel-brown fine-knit quarter-zip long-sleeve sweater over a white collared shirt. Charcoal-grey tailored wool trousers and dark-brown leather loafers. All plain, with no logos.. Signature colour: brown. Expression in the close-up shows: Weak-willed and conflict-averse. He feels some guilt toward Natalie and his ex-wife but is dominated by Lauren, who controls the money. He hedges, mumbles and ends up saying nothing..
The outfit is identical in every view and in the close-up: the same garments, accessories and details on the same side of the body, seen from that view's angle (an earring on the left ear stays on the left ear; a tie, a pocket square, gloves or hair ribbons are in every view or in none). Garments are plain, with no logo, brand mark, or printed letters or numbers.

Avoid: a different face between the views, an older-looking or younger-looking face than 55, doll-like face, a second outfit, extra people, extra limbs, text or labels.
